versions.content: The CanTSyn shall only accept a FUP message with an identical Sequence Counter to the value of the corresponding SYNC message and Type equal to 0x18 or a FUP message with an identical sequence counter to the value of the corresponding SYNC message and Type equal to 0x28 and a correct CRC value if CanTSynRxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_OPTIONAL.
